race.comment: LIGHTNING MY QUEEN (1) came from a tough draw to finish midfield when resuming from a layoff off 18 months here last week. She'll be fitter for that and is better served by the inside draw. DOIN YA BEST (4) is stepping out for the first time. By Be Happy Mach and hails from the David White stable. Was not far away in his latest trial and should be ready to go. INTERNAL BLUE (3) draws better than in her first-up seventh here a week ago. She is open to improvement. ON SIDE (2) draws well and is a possible improver after debuting with a respectable fifth last week.
